info.title: Storm Glass Universal API
info.description: Storm Glass provides global weather, marine, tide, astronomy, solar, bio, historical weather, and elevation data by coordinate through a REST API.

get.description: Retrieves astronomy data from Storm Glass.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

schema.description: Latitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

schema.description: Longitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional UTC start timestamp as UNIX time or URL-encoded ISO time.

schema.description: Optional UTC start timestamp as UNIX time or URL-encoded ISO time.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Optional UTC end date or timestamp. Storm Glass returns astronomy data for up to 10 days.

schema.description: Optional UTC end date or timestamp. Storm Glass returns astronomy data for up to 10 days.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Daily astronomy records for the requested coordinate.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves historical weather data from Storm Glass.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

schema.description: Latitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

schema.description: Longitude of the desired coordinate in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Comma-separated historical weather parameters to retrieve, such as airTemperature,windSpeed,waveHeight.

schema.description: Comma-separated historical weather parameters to retrieve, such as airTemperature,windSpeed,waveHeight.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: UTC first hour as UNIX time or ISO time. Historical requests require a start and end window.

schema.description: UTC first hour as UNIX time or ISO time. Historical requests require a start and end window.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: UTC final hour as UNIX time or ISO time. Each historical response covers up to 10 days.

schema.description: UTC final hour as UNIX time or ISO time. Each historical response covers up to 10 days.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional source such as sg, ecmwf, ecmwf:era5, cmems, or cmems:gopaf.

schema.description: Optional source such as sg, ecmwf, ecmwf:era5, cmems, or cmems:gopaf.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

hours.description: Hourly historical weather records for the requested coordinate and time window.
